info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v4-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API enables users to verify the authenticity of event tickets. This endpoint allows for the batch validation of tickets to ensure they are valid for entry. Typical consumers include event organizers, ticketing platforms, and venue management systems who need to streamline entry processes and prevent fraud. By confirming ticket validity in real-time, businesses can enhance customer experience and operational efficiency while minimizing unauthorized access.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to validate a ticket by checking its validity status and related details. Ensure the ticket identifier is provided for accurate validation.

requestBody.description: Request body for validating ticket information. Ensure that the required fields are populated correctly to avoid validation errors.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and ticket validation passed.
